items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Henry' in the context of receiving pictures from 'Fat' (likely Fat Matlock or similar, given the 'Fat's got married' context), not directly from Henry Kimball. The interviewer introduces Henry Kimball later, and the interviewee only confirms knowledge of 'Fade Marable', not

ctx.x: You see, what kept him up with them, he kept up with the music, you see. And when Fat's got married, he and I were buddies like that. You could tell the way we got together. We were old time buddies. His mother partly raised me. See, my mother died when I was 12. His mother partly raised me. Now Fat's and I were together, but when he got married, I was still single. He got married before me. And that made a difference in him and I because every time we'd go out, his wife could blame me for it. Yeah. So then I…
Get me a cover. Well, this is just about to run out here.
